# Load Libraries

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(targets)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)

```

# Load data
```{r}
tar_load(c(macrofactor_daily, macrofactor_exercise), 
         store = here("_targets"))
```

# Exploration of daily data


```{r}
#| echo: FALSE


macrofactor_daily %>% 
  mutate(year = as.factor(year(date))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = calories_kcal, y = weight_kg)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = year), shape = 21) +
  geom_smooth() +
  theme_physdev() +
  scale_fill_health()+
  stat_cor() +
  labs(y = "Trend weight (kg)",
       x= "Calories (kcal)")

```
